scope: Actual beginner-shop module and native Chrome DOM/dialog/input; isolated Chrome context with a fresh page per case; gated local synthetic wallet operations and reads; no account, real wallet, audio or remote requests
checks: Keyboard purchase captures the requested item once, reports the decoration purchase and moves to its Use action.
Keyboard equip preserves the requested slot and returns to the selected owned card when its action disappears.
Delayed decoration purchase survives close/reopen without claiming a picnic purchase, changing the new selection or stealing its Close focus.
An accepted delayed equip still applies its original slot but cannot overwrite a newly opened default preview or its focus/message.
Moving focus to another live button while purchase saves is preserved after refresh.
Clicking a blank nonfocusable face cancels deferred focus; purchase completion preserves the native dialog/body focus.
Async read refresh restores the same keyboard-selected card after rebuilding its DOM.
Out-of-order open/read completion cannot reset the latest requested selection or its focus.
Goal save/clear keeps its original request and keyboard continuation while respecting a later blank-face click.
Rejected storage preserves coins, ownership and appearance, keeps Retry by purchase keyboard focus, and fits at 320px.
